title: Test: evaluateTiming reports the exact minutes remaining when too soon
description: This is the number shown directly in the warning dialog the user sees, so it must be exactly right for a whole-minute remainder.
acceptance_criteria: @Test fun evaluateTiming_tooSoon_reportsExactMinutesRemaining() constructs a DoseLog given at 0L with a 60-minute interval, evaluates a candidate 10 minutes before the boundary (50 * 60_000L), asserts the result is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon, and asserts its minutesRemaining equals 10L
